hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit push\b'; then python3 ./scripts/check_alembic_heads.py; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit push\b'; then if git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'generated_ads.py'; then echo 'kie.ai change detected — running live /test-kie...' >&2; RESULT=$(curl -sf --max-time 30 'https://adbuilder-api.velocitymx.io/api/v1/generated-ads/test-kie' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$RESULT" ]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "BLOCKED: generated_ads.py changed but /test-kie is unreachable. The VPS may still be deploying — wait 60s and retry, or check VPS health."}'; exit 0; fi; PASS=$(echo "$RESULT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); r=[x for x in d.get('results',[]) if not x.get('skipped')]; ok=r and all(x.get('body',{}).get('code')==200 and x.get('body',{}).get('data',{}).get('taskId') for x in r); print('yes' if ok else 'no')" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$PASS" != 'yes' ]; then echo "{\"continue\": false, \"stopReason\": \"BLOCKED: kie.ai /test-kie not passing. Both tests must return code 200 + taskId before a generated_ads.py push. Hit https://adbuilder-api.velocitymx.io/api/v1/generated-ads/test-kie to see what's failing. Fix the contract, verify the test passes, then retry the push.\"}" ; fi; fi; fi
